meaning: The ruler of a very big country.
example: The emperor loved new clothes.

meaning: Things that you wear.
example: He spent all his money on clothes.

meaning: A room for choosing and putting on clothes.
example: The emperor is in his dressing room.

meaning: A metal piece on a shoe or belt.
example: He had shoes with silver buckles.

meaning: Glass where you see your face.
example: He stood in front of the big mirror.

meaning: A person who tricks people to get money.
example: Two swindlers came to the city.

meaning: A person who makes cloth.
example: We are weavers from a faraway land.

meaning: The material that clothes are made of.
example: It is the finest cloth in the world.

meaning: Shapes and colors repeated on cloth.
example: Do you not admire the pattern?

meaning: A big machine for making cloth.
example: They asked for two looms.

meaning: A very soft, shiny cloth.
example: They asked for the best silk.

meaning: A long thin line for sewing or weaving.
example: They did not put in a single thread.

meaning: Thread made of gold.
example: They took all the gold thread.

meaning: Good enough to do his work.
example: A man who is not fit for his job cannot see it.

meaning: Not clever.
example: Only a stupid man cannot see it.

meaning: An important helper of a ruler.
example: The old minister was an honest man.

meaning: Telling the truth.
example: He is an honest man.

meaning: A person with an important job in the government.
example: The official could see nothing.

meaning: To say that something is very good.
example: He praised the cloth.

meaning: A sign that you think something is good.
example: It has our highest approval.

meaning: A small metal disk given as a prize.
example: The emperor gave each of them a medal.

meaning: A tool for cutting.
example: They cut the air with big scissors.

meaning: A thin sharp tool for sewing.
example: They sewed with needles.

meaning: Clothes for the legs.
example: These are the trousers.

meaning: A long coat without sleeves.
example: Here is the cloak.

meaning: The thin net that a spider makes.
example: They are as light as a cobweb.

meaning: Very beautiful and grand.
example: It is a magnificent suit.

meaning: A cover held over a person in a procession.
example: He walked under a beautiful canopy.

meaning: A line of people walking in a special event.
example: There was a great procession.

meaning: The long back part of a cloak.
example: They carried the train that did not exist.

meaning: The people who work for a ruler.
example: The men of his court admired the cloth.

meaning: A person who works in a house.
example: The servants carried the train.

meaning: A big group of people.
example: He heard the crowd.

meaning: Having done nothing wrong; honest like a child.
example: Listen to the voice of an innocent child.

meaning: To speak very quietly.
example: He whispered to the man next to him.

meaning: A calm and proud way of behaving.
example: He walked on with great dignity.

meaning: Not covered by clothes.
example: He saw only his bare skin.

meaning: To shake a little because of cold or fear.
example: He felt a shiver go down his back.

meaning: To shout with joy.
example: The people began to cheer.

meaning: To look at something with pleasure.
example: Everyone admired the clothes.

meaning: Very happy.
example: Everybody seemed to be delighted.

meaning: An open place in a town.
example: The procession came to a big square.

meaning: A place where people buy and sell.
example: They stood in the market square.

meaning: A very large country with an emperor.
example: He ruled a big empire.

meaning: To act as if something is true when it is not.
example: They pretended to be busy.

meaning: Very pleased with yourself.
example: He was proud of his mind.
